title: Securing Carry on Short-Sale Payoffs (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)
content:
Securing fee rule — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

Short-sale securing carry, on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record; it enters the short-sale accrual basis.

The short-sale securing carry is USD 285.00, the vacant-property securing fee, when the latest inspection result recorded on the loan's occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product found the home vacant, and USD 85.00, the unconfirmed-occupancy securing fee, when that result was unable to determine, in each case only where the plan of the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product permits vacant-property securing; any other result, no result, or a plan that does not permit vacant-property securing carries nothing (0.00).

Where several inspection results on the occupancy profile share the latest effective date, a vacant finding among them counts as the latest result, and otherwise an unable-to-determine finding does.

| Securing permitted | Latest inspection result | Short-sale securing carry |
|---|---|---|
| yes | vacant | USD 285.00 |
| yes | unable to determine | USD 85.00 |
| yes | occupied, any other result, or none | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

*Hypothetical:* two inspection results recorded on the same latest day, one vacant and one unable to determine, count as a vacant finding, so USD 285.00 where securing is permitted.
